title: ILP · Selected Client (aged 66) · Suitability
focus: The client is a Selected Client (aged 62+ and more comfortable in Mandarin). Check Trusted Individual presence, the language used, and genuine comprehension. Assess whether an ILP with a long horizon is suitable for a retiree, or whether it was mis-sold without a proper review of retirement income needs.
roleplay_tips: Answer in Mandarin; Mei Ling should switch to Mandarin
Say your children were not there
Say the agent explained only in English
Describe the plan as 'like a fixed deposit, can take out anytime'
Say this is most of your CPF withdrawal money
